title: Pharmacokinetic Clearance Modeling for Feature Activation Decay

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Understanding feature persistence across layers could explain context loss, which has safety implications (e.g., forgetting safety instructions). The PK framing adds quantitative rigor. Indirect safety relevance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires tracking SAE feature activations across layers and fitting PK models with scipy. TransformerLens and SAELens provide the data. PK model fitting is standard curve fitting. Moderate for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Track activations across layers for selected features, fit PK curves, compare clearance rates. Bounded and well-defined. Feasible in 30 hours on one model with 10-20 features.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
